maya: eval-bot just flagged a big regression in the nightly summarization eval :eyes:

maya: ROUGE-L dropped from 0.62 -> 0.47 on the anchor set, repeat_rate jumped 3.8% -> 22%. A few example outputs show immediate token repetition (same token repeated 6-8x).

eval-bot: automated report:
```
run: nightly-eval-2026-03-19
model: redwood/grove-7B-q4f (canary)
metric: ROUGE-L 0.472 (-0.148)
repeat_rate: 0.219 (+0.181)
example_ids: [s-102, s-209, s-311]
link: https://ci.internal/evals/2180001234
```

rohan: fyi i merged attn-tiling microkernel change earlier this week (7f3c2a4). it touched softmax normalization and the tiling reorder path. i also landed a small sampling refactor to reuse the same rng buffer. could be an interaction.

sasha: i can reproduce locally on a quantized build (q4f) with seed=42. snippet from a failing run:
```
> prompt: "Summarize the following article..."
> generated: "The study found that that that that that..."
> top_tokens: [the(0.34), study(0.12), that(0.11), found(0.05)]
```

sasha: toggling `--disable-attn-tiling` makes the repetition go away in my run.

maya: great repro, thanks. rohan — can you try a quick bisect or flip the runtime flag on canary? if it's the tile reorder, reverting should be fast.

aaron: while you do that, run deterministic comparisons: temp=0.8 seed=42, dump logits for first 32 steps on both builds and diff top-5. if probs diverge early it's likely attention math change, if probs stay close but sampling differs it's rng path. also watch kv-cache ordering (we saw issues before where prefetch changed order).

rohan: running canary vs pre-merge now on a small batch (3 prompts). will post diffs. ETA ~20m. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

eval-bot: added failing prompt ids to the triage ticket #T-739, attached examples (s-102, s-209, s-311) and raw model outputs.

sasha: one more note — quantization rescales interact with softmax underflow. adding a small clamp (1e-6) to exp(normed_logits) reduced the repeats in my quick test, but that's a band-aid. root cause still looks like reorder + rng reuse.

maya: ok i'm adding this to the kernel triage board and pinging oncall. rohan, once you have diffs paste them here and i'll assign follow-ups (bisect, revert, add unit test with the failing prompts). thanks everyone :sparkles:

rohan: posted diffs in the ticket and linked the canary run logs. initial look: logits diverge starting at step 4, top-5 changes by step 6. looks like the attention path changed accumulation order. continuing bisect.

maya: good signal. i'll prep test cases.

aaron: if you need a quick reproducer for CI i can add a tiny eval that asserts repeat_rate < 5% for the anchor prompts.

maya: yes please add that test. moving to high priority. :rocket:
